questions.stem: A 40 year old woman with three children who has been using OCPs for 5 years is a current smoker, has a BMI of 27, menarche at 13, and has a family history of endometriosis, is concerned about her risk of developing the condition. Which best describes her endometriosis risk profile?

options.label: A
options.text: High risk due to family history

options.label: B
options.text: High risk due to increased age

options.label: C
options.text: Low risk due to multiple protective factors
